message.content:
I’m happy to help you keep track of what’s new at the cinema!  
Because my training only goes through **mid‑2024**, I don’t have real‑world data on titles released *after* that point—so I can’t name specific films that hit theaters or streams in late 2025/early 2026.  

Below is a quick snapshot of the kinds of projects that were slated for release around the end of 2024 and early 2025, plus a short guide on where to look for the very newest drops:

| Release window | Major studio / platform | Notable titles announced (as of mid‑2024) |
|-----------------|------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| **Summer 2024** | Disney+ & theatrical | “The Marvels” (Disney), “Fast X – Part 1” (Universal) |
| **Fall 2024**   | Warner Bros., Netflix | “Dune: Part Two” (Warner Bros.), “Glass Onion” (Netflix) |
| **Winter 2024–25** | Sony Pictures, Amazon Prime Video | “Spider‑Man: Across the Spider‑Verse” (Sony), “The Last Voyage of the Demeter” (Amazon) |
| **Spring 2025** | Paramount, Hulu | “Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning” (Paramount), “Boys Don’t Cry” (Hulu) |

> **Tip:** If you’re looking for truly up‑to‑date information, check out one of these resources:
>
> - **IMDb Upcoming Releases** – lists scheduled premieres worldwide.  
> - **Rotten Tomatoes New Movies** – shows trailers, release dates, and critic buzz.  
> - **Box Office Mojo** – tracks domestic/theatrical openings week by week.  
> - **Film festival calendars** (Cannes, Sundance, Toronto, SXSW) – many world‑premieres debut there before wide distribution.  
> - **Official studio press sites** (e.g., Disney Newsroom, WarnerMedia Press Center) – they publish official release schedules.  
> - **Streaming services’ “New Arrivals” pages** – most platforms update daily; e.g., HBO Max, Apple TV+, Peacock, Discovery+.  

If you let me know your preferred genre(s)—action, drama, animation, horror, documentaries—I can narrow down a handful of highly anticipated titles that fit those categories based on the latest pre‑release chatter.
